"""Model of a test that validates stored citations against the source file length."""

import re
from pathlib import Path

CITATION_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^(?P<path>[\w/]+\.py):(?P<line>\d+)$")
CITATIONS = ["src/comet/domain_registry.py:1160"]


def test_source_citations_for_path_facts_exist_in_the_repository() -> None:
    """Require every stored citation line to stay within the current file length."""
    for citation in CITATIONS:
        match = CITATION_PATTERN.match(citation)
        assert match is not None
        path = Path(match.group("path"))
        line_number = int(match.group("line"))
        line_count = len(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())
        assert 0 < line_number <= line_count, f"{citation} exceeds {line_count}"
